text: Implemented lawful ScalarKind execution (bool, signed/unsigned 8-64, float32/64), removed data-type name dispatch from scalar bytes/assembly/write validation, added shape-aware ExecutableArrayCodec plus normative transpose, and added default/v2 ChunkKeyEncoding. NeuroArchive explicitly refines to default keys; dataset/NIfTI adapters handle widened carriers. Evidence: zarrJVM 89/89, zarrJS 87/87, archive-zarr JVM 11/11 + JS 8/8, dataset-zarr JVM 7/7 + JS 3/3, compileAll green, and bidirectional Zarr-Python 3.2.1 oracle green for all supported scalar carriers, transpose/v2, sharding, uint64 extremes, CRC corruption, and missing-codec refusal.
